label: Logical falsity, from Generation from Night: some BEING_1 is in… and 4 more
meaning: Compose the existing GENERATION-FROM-NIGHT-REFUTED.coreFromRootPremises theorem with the Night commitment. The four other commitments imply that the Night reading is false; the supplied Night witness therefore yields logical falsity. This exposes the already proved root-premise incompatibility to configuration propagation; it is not a new philosophical refutation and selects no member for rejection. The mover, actuality, act/potency and simple-priority assumptions share the same Being, Respect and predicates. The simple-priority bridge is unattributed and open. No excluded middle is needed. Inclusion-minimality is a separate obligation requiring a joint checked witness for every single-member deletion. No root premise closes.
